description:
The whole market in one reading: how many perps lean bullish vs bearish on
liquidation pressure, and the markets leaning hardest each way.

The score compares short-liquidation exposure ABOVE price (forced buys if price
rises) with long-liquidation exposure BELOW it (forced sells if it falls),
weighted by distance. Negative = more fuel below, a bearish pull; positive = the
reverse. Uses 2 API calls.
